-- coding.helper.enforce_quota
-- Reads a per-job byte quota from config [ default 4096 ]
-- and logs a warning when a job's usage exceeds it, returning FALSE in that case.

local config = require "config"
local log = require "log"

local function enforce_quota(job_name, usage)
    local quota = config["job_quota"] or 4096
    if usage > quota then
        log.warning("job %q exceeded quota: %d bytes used, %d bytes allowed",
                    job_name, usage, quota)
        return false
    end
    return true
end

return { enforce_quota = enforce_quota }
